tuning.bad_format: The advanced settings format is invalid.
tuning.err_regex_empty: {label} must not match an empty input.
tuning.group.tell: How the voice is told to speak
tuning.instructions_always.label: Always-added speaking style
tuning.instructions_always.about: This text is put at the start of the speaking style sent to Irodori every time. Leave it empty to add nothing. The style and emotion the LLM writes follow it.
tuning.instructions_sep.label: Separator between styles
tuning.instructions_sep.about: The characters that join the always-added style, the LLM's style and the emotion.
tuning.steps.label: Irodori generation steps
tuning.lines_per_turn.label: Lines per turn
tuning.lines_per_turn.about: How many lines the LLM writes at a time.
tuning.max_chars.label: Maximum characters per line
tuning.max_chars.about: The maximum number of characters in one line.
tuning.emoji_keep.label: Keep emoji
tuning.emoji_keep.about: When off, all emoji are removed from the spoken text and the emotion. When on, only those in the bundled emoji table are kept ({emoji} in the prompts lists them).
tuning.stage_pattern.label: Stage directions to drop
tuning.stage_pattern.about: Matches parts that should not be read, such as text in brackets. Leave empty to drop nothing.
tuning.kaomoji_pattern.label: Emoticons to drop
tuning.kaomoji_pattern.about: Matches bracketed text that contains no kana or kanji. Leave empty to drop nothing.
tuning.symbol_pattern.label: Unreadable symbols to drop
tuning.symbol_pattern.about: Matches symbols that break the reading. Leave empty to drop nothing.
tuning.voice_words.label: Words that name a voice
tuning.voice_words.about: If your request contains one of these, the voice is chosen again from the voice description the LLM writes. Leave empty to never choose again.
tuning.change_pattern.label: Signal to change the voice
tuning.change_pattern.about: If your input starts with this, the voice is changed, and the matched part is removed before sending. Leave empty to use no signal.
tuning.preload.label: Clips to preload
tuning.preload.about: How many waiting clips the browser loads before they play.
tuning.stock_low.label: Remaining clips that trigger a continue request
tuning.stock_low.about: When the lines not yet played drop to this number or fewer, the LLM is asked for more.
tuning.lead_min.label: Seconds left before making the next clip (minimum)
tuning.lead_min.about: The next voice is not started until the current one has less than this many seconds left.
tuning.lead_factor.label: Seconds left before making the next clip (generation-time factor)
tuning.lead_factor.about: The recent generation time times this factor is also compared with the minimum, and the longer one is used.
tuning.pause_default.label: Default pause between voices (seconds)
tuning.pause_default.about: Used for lines where the LLM wrote no pause.
tuning.seed_mode.label: How the seed is chosen
tuning.seed_mode.about: With Fixed, choosing the voice again uses the same seed, so you get the same voice. The seed for retries still changes.
tuning.seed_value.label: Fixed seed
tuning.seed_value.about: Used when the mode is Fixed.
tuning.reverb_check.label: Remake lines that echo
tuning.reverb_check.about: Lines that sound as if spoken in a room with echo are made again.
tuning.reverb_db.label: Reverb threshold (dB)
tuning.reverb_db.about: How far below the speech the sound right after it stops must fall. -30 means 30 dB lower; a clip whose tail is louder than that is made again. Closer to 0 accepts more reverb.
tuning.reverb_max_redo.label: Reverb retries (maximum)
tuning.reverb_max_redo.about: How many times a new voice is made again because of reverb. If every try is too reverberant, the driest one is used.
tuning.clip_keep_ms.label: Length kept around speech (ms)
tuning.clip_keep_ms.about: How much is kept before and after the voice when silence is trimmed.
tuning.clip_fade_ms.label: Fade at the cut (ms)
tuning.clip_fade_ms.about: A fade length that avoids click noise at the cut.
tuning.clip_threshold.label: Level that counts as speech
tuning.clip_threshold.about: Anything at or above this share of the maximum level counts as voice. 0.05 is about -26 dB.
tuning.clip_peak_db.label: Peak limit (dBFS)
tuning.clip_peak_db.about: The whole clip is turned down only when it goes above this.
tuning.check_sec_min.label: Shortest seconds per character
tuning.check_sec_min.about: Faster than this counts as too short, and the clip is made again.
tuning.check_sec_max.label: Longest seconds per character
tuning.check_sec_max.about: Slower than this counts as too long, and the clip is made again.
tuning.check_min_speech.label: Minimum share of speech
tuning.check_min_speech.about: If the voiced part is less than this share of the whole length, the clip is made again.
tuning.check_min_chars.label: Shortest text to length-check
tuning.check_min_chars.about: Lines shorter than this are not checked for seconds per character.
tuning.max_redo.label: Maximum retries
tuning.max_redo.about: How many times a clip that fails the checks is made again with another seed.
tuning.max_fails.label: Failures before stopping
tuning.max_fails.about: After this many failures in a row to make audio, playback stops and the reason is shown.
tuning.asr_min_match.label: Match level that counts as misread
tuning.asr_min_match.about: When “Check for misreading by transcription” is on, a clip that matches less than this is made again.
tuning.history_turns.label: History turns sent to the LLM
tuning.history_turns.about: The LLM rereads this many recent exchanges each time. Claude Code and Codex start a new session after this many turns and receive only the requests and the story so far. Larger values remember more but use more tokens.
tuning.handover_lines.label: Heard lines handed over when the LLM changes
tuning.handover_lines.about: When the LLM type, model or prompts change, the new session is told the requests, this many of the most recently played lines, the line now playing and the lines still waiting. 0 hands over no played lines.
tuning.lm_temperature.label: LM Studio temperature
tuning.lm_temperature.about: Higher values make the text vary more.
tuning.lm_max_tokens.label: LM Studio max tokens
tuning.lm_max_tokens.about: The upper limit for one reply.
tuning.codex_idle_limit.label: Longest wait for a Codex reply (seconds)
tuning.codex_idle_limit.about: If nothing arrives for this many seconds, it counts as a failure.
tuning.claude_start_timeout.label: Longest wait for Claude Code to start (seconds)
tuning.claude_start_timeout.about: If the startup check gets no reply within this many seconds, it counts as a failure.

prompt.style.label: Writing style instructions
prompt.style.about: The first half of the system prompt. Write the rules for what kind of text to write and in what style: lectures, readings, role-play and so on.
prompt.format.label: Output format
prompt.format.about: The second half of the system prompt. The app reads one JSON per line that has a say field. If you break this shape, the text can no longer be read.
prompt.request.label: First request
prompt.request.about: Sent when you submit from the input box for the first time.
prompt.steer.label: Remark while playing
prompt.steer.about: Sent when you type while audio is playing. A line that holds only {heard} (text heard so far), {now_playing} or {dropped} (discarded plan) is left out when it has no content.
prompt.more.label: Continue request
prompt.more.about: Sent when the plan that has not played yet runs low.
prompt.retry.label: Rewrite request
prompt.retry.about: Sent once when the reply could not be read.
prompt.ready.label: Startup check (Claude Code)
prompt.ready.about: Sent right after Claude Code starts; once a reply comes, it counts as ready.
prompt.ping.label: Connection test
prompt.ping_system.label: Connection test instructions (Codex)
prompt.ping_system.about: Passed as the system prompt in the Codex connection test.

set.imported_skipped: ({n} skipped because the names already exist)
set.asr_help: A clip that was misread is made again. It works only when reading Japanese. This raises the load on your computer.
set.save_restart: Save and restart the voice model
set.keep_help: WAV and JSON of the lines you keep with the ★ under “Text so far” go here. This is separate from saving a voice.
set.other_prompts: Other prompts sent to the LLM (format, request, continue, etc.)
set.other_prompts_help: Every text sent to the LLM can be changed here. If you empty one and save, the default is restored. Only the names in { } that are listed are replaced; everything else is sent as written.
help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
r21.rec_hint: Press the mic again or {commit} to confirm, {cancel} to cancel. Nothing is sent until you press Enter.
r21.sc.edit_help: Click a field, then press the keys you want (Ctrl, Alt and Shift can be combined). Backspace clears it, and clicking elsewhere cancels. Changes are saved at once.
r21.sc.conflict: Same key as: {names}. Only the first one in this list works.
r21.reset_all_ask: The writing style and every other prompt go back to their defaults, and what is written now is lost. Until you save, “Discard and close” undoes this.
r21.reset_all_done: All prompts are back to the defaults. Press Save to keep this, or “Discard and close” to undo.
r21.web_search_help: Searches only when the request needs checking (latest news, today's information). Works with Claude and Codex.
tuning.how_max.label: Maximum characters of the speaking manner (how)
tuning.how_max.about: Fills {how_max} in the prompts. The LLM is told to put only a short phrase here. A longer value, or one that reads like a sentence (an answer or explanation), is thrown away and logged, so it never reaches Irodori.
tuning.feel_max.label: Maximum characters of the emotion (feel)
tuning.feel_max.about: Fills {feel_max} in the prompts. A longer value, or one that reads like a sentence, is thrown away and logged.
tuning.voice_max.label: Maximum characters of the voice description (voice)
tuning.voice_max.about: Fills {voice_max} in the prompts. A longer value, or one that reads like a sentence, is thrown away and logged.
prompt.handover.label: Handover to a new session
prompt.handover.about: Put before the first request when the LLM, its model or the prompts were changed during a reading, so that the new session can continue from the same point. A line whose list is empty is left out.
prompt.search.label: When web search is allowed
prompt.search.about: Added to the end of the system prompt when "Use web search" is on (Claude Code and Codex).
prompt.no_search.label: When web search is not available
prompt.no_search.about: Added to the end of the system prompt when searching is off or not possible (LM Studio).
